blocks.text: People often visit malls, cafes, libraries and parks as their third places. However, these spaces may not always be accessible, as some require people to spend money to relax and socialize. American sociologist Ray Oldenburg coined the term “third place” to describe spaces where people gather informally outside their homes and workplaces. These spaces allow people to destress and engage in social interaction. For many Filipinos, having a space apart from home and school is important.
